chapters.reason: The paper proposes generating contemplation tokens as compressed representations of explicit reasoning chains, aligning with semantic anchoring's focus on compressing full traces into contemplation tokens to ensure semantic fidelity.

The method allows adaptive control over reasoning by generating variable-length contemplation tokens, matching adaptive efficiency's emphasis on dynamic trajectory compression and adjusting reasoning length.

The approach manipulates individual contemplation tokens during inference, fitting token-level steering with non-interpretable latent tokens, though it avoids generating full explicit CoT text sequences.
